rationale: Pinned text method path preserves a directly returned SemanticError verbatim. A private immutable PreservedContext origin barrier keeps automatic record/index paths and public-position offsets from decorating that cause; ordinary JSON semantic errors still compose. Each public Result/JsonEncoded boundary removes only this private barrier, preserving the exact original public family and cause. No mutation, string normalization, oracle change, user JsonReturnedError stripping, or public error flattening.
ownership: Barrier holds the original immutable JsonError directly; no byte copies/mutable continuation cell/new runtime intrinsic. All semantic getters are transparent to the barrier.
